q: Does chromite ore face CBAM, and what figure will buyers ask for?
title: Chromite ore and CBAM
short: Chromite ore itself is not a CBAM good. Ferro-chromium made from it is (CN 7202 4), so a ferrochrome smelter's EU importer needs emissions that include the ore. Miners can expect requests for diesel, electricity and tonnes mined per tonne of ore.

ul: Charge chrome or ferrochrome made from your ore carries the smelter's emissions, not the mine's, under CBAM.

p: Monthly diesel, explosives, electricity and tonnes of ore dispatched. These feed the smelter's supply chain figures.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions an EU importer asks for.
